name: Caroline McWilliams
bio: Caroline McWilliams was an American actress best known for her portrayal of Marcy Hill in the television series Benson. She also appeared in nine episodes of its parent-series Soap as Sally. She was a regular on the CBS soap Guiding Light where she played Janet Norris for several years and appeared in a short-term role on the NBC soap Another World as Tracy DeWitt. She also had a recurring role on Beverly Hills, 90210 playing the mother of Jamie Walters' character, Ray Pruit.
